Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hello, Buford, I hear you are under the weather and I have just the thing to cheer you up.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (sighs) Not that lame sci-fi show you obsess over. Space Adventure?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It got me through hoof and mouth disease. And I have already downloaded my favorite episode.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hard pass! I'd rather wallow in misery.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Too bad. You are a captive audience and cannot leave. Here goes!

Name: Captain Dirk Mortenson
Dialog: (voiceover) Diary of Captain Dirk Mortenson

Name: Sophia Sharkboard
Dialog: Cadet Sophia Sharkboard, captain.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Right. Welcome aboard. You've met everyone? Second-in-command, the fierce and determined Lieutenant Zarna, Nosh, the 17th best pilot in the galaxy...

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (roars)

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Oh, right. 19th. And there's our security officer, Lomond, master of the profound mystical arts of... Schlufbaum's Luck.

Name: Lomond
Dialog: Oof!

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Nice to meet you, but this is a mistake. I'm just an intern. I shouldn't be navigating.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Calm down, noob. You've got decent grades and we need a navigator, case closed. Now, status report, Newbie Navigator!

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Uh, we're approaching the Honey Badger home planet.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Deploy the harmless asteroid camouflage.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: We'll take a shuttle and sneak aboard the command station where they keep their secret plans. Nosh, Zarna, Lomond, you're with me! (to the robot) DSL-4, you're in charge.

Name: DSL-4
Dialog: (beeps)

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Okay. Only one officer between us and the plans. We gotta take him out quietly.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Zarna, Zarna! (Shakes his head) Not again. Three times since we snuck aboard is enough. Plus, I think you enjoy it a little much.

Name: Zarna
Dialog: I enjoy it just enough, thank you.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: You have a problem. Lomond, try using those powers of yours to knock him out with something.

Name: Lomond
Dialog: I don't think I can, sir.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: You can do it.

Name: Honey Badger Guard
Dialog: My stuff! What the—?!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Whew! Thank goodness for my patented Mortenson chop.

Name: Zarna
Dialog: (types) I'm in. Accessing plans. Captain, their first target is listed here. It's... Earth!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Earth?! Again?! Of all the planets in the galaxy, of which there are many, why is it always Earth? Okay, we've gotta get these plans to the Space Fleet so they can find the weakness and stop that spike. Let's go.

Name: Tech Officer #1
Dialog: Hey, you janitors aren't supposed to be in here!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: (sighs) Go ahead.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Newbie Navigator, any sign they've detected the Minotaur?

Name: Sophia
Dialog: None, sir!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Set a course for Earth, Nosh!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Aw, I just thought of something really cool we could do right now!

Name: Zarna
Dialog: Not that.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Execute the Galaxy Famous Mortenson Victory Flyby!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: (taunting) We've got your plans! Bite me, Honey Badgers!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait! They got away undetected?! Why would he come back like that?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Because it was cool!

Name: Caption
Dialog: The Safehouse Nebula - 2 Hours Later

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Lucky we lost the Honey Badgers. Mission accomplished.

Name: Zarna
Dialog: Was that really necessary?

Name: Dirk
Dialog: You're not still carrying on about the Mortenson Victory Flyby, are you? You know us Earth men. (dances) We gotta celebrate life's wins! (Turns to Lomond, who is concentrating on lifting rocks with his mind.) Lomond, can you sense if the Honey Badger— (Lomond breaks his concentration.) Dah! Hey! I thought we talked about you keeping those rocks on the bridge.

Name: Lomond
Dialog: Sorry, sir. I'm still learning the ways of Schlufbaum's Luck. I—

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Okay, okay, okay. See if you can use that Schlufbaum's Luck of yours and detect the Honey Badgers' fleet out there.

Name: Lomond
Dialog: I will try, sir. (struggles)

Name: Zarna
Dialog: Why not use the ship's sensors?

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Lt. Zarna, Schlufbaum's Luck is a power that goes back to when the universe was young. We can't turn our backs on—

Name: Zarna
Dialog: Already picking up the incoming Honey Badger fleet.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Do you sense the Honey Badger fleet?

Name: Lomond
Dialog: No.

Name: Zarna
Dialog: Sensors read twenty Honey Badgers ships.

Name: Lomond
Dialog: I am sensing... evil. But the universe is a dangerous place, Captain, I kind of sense evil all the time. Wow!

Name: Lomond
Dialog: Sir, I'm sensing the Honey Badger fleet approaching!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Nice work, Lomond.

Name: Commander Rrrrrg
Dialog: Captain Dirk Mortenson!

Name: Lomond
Dialog: (yelps)

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Lomond!

Name: Lomond
Dialog: I'm sorry, sir, it's—

Name: Dirk
Dialog: He's not here in the room! Commander Rrrrrg, what can I do for you?

Name: Commander
Dialog: Captain, your crazy maneuver scared the dickens out of our techs! I should blow your ship to bits, but I'll cancel that and the spike launch if you just apologize.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Commander Rrrrrg, you don't apologize for doing something cool.

Name: Commander
Dialog: Mortenson, you fool! You have 49 seconds to reconsider apologizing or we're blowing your ship to bits!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Not gonna happen.

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Captain, couldn't we try firing all our space torpedos and take our chances escaping?

Name: Dirk
Dialog: No, we could fire all our space torpedoes, but their shielding is too strong. It would only anger them! Nosh, did you fire all our space torpedoes at them?!?!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Nosh, did you?

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (shrieks in confirmation)

Name: Dirk
Dialog: It says here we have zero torpedoes left.

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (shrieks)

Name: Dirk
Dialog: No, Nosh. I don't think we forgot to bring torpedoes on the mission.

Name: Commander
Dialog: (back on screen) That's what you get for firing on us, Captain! Now prepare to be destroyed! You may have 49 seconds to say goodbye to your crew. Or, maybe, you could just say sorry to these two and we could forget the whole thing.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Not gonna happen. (Turns screen back off and goes to his chair) We've got to get these plans to Earth. (Presses a button on his chair) Chief Engineer Hondu...

Name: Dirk
Dialog: (on speaker) ...engine status.

Name: Hondu
Dialog: I'm doing what I can to repair them, but that last sonic blast damaged our engines. We won't outrun them!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Then we'll have to escape using a course so dangerous the Honey Badger fleet wouldn't dare follow. Newbie Navigator, set course 23/49-23!

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (shrieks in fear)

Name: Zarna
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Sophia
Dialog: But, Captain, that will take us straight through—

Name: Dirk
Dialog: That's right, Newbie Navigator! (dramatic closeup) The Giant Space Worms Nebula! Nosh, full engines! Go!

Name: Zarna
Dialog: The Honey Badgers are slowing down.

Name: Zarna
Dialog: Captain, I'm counting... a lot of giant space worms. We are sure to be eaten.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: If we hold this steady course, we might slide through unnoticed.

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Captain, can we use the laser cannons on it?

Name: Dirk
Dialog: The outer layer of the worm is too strong. The only things effective against them are... (yelling, at Nosh) SPACE TORPEDOES!!

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (shrieks)

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Lomond, can you use your Schlufbaum's Luck telepathy to tell the Space Worm we mean no harm?

Name: Lomond
Dialog: I will try, sir. (struggles) Making... (struggles) Contact! (struggles)

Name: Lomond
Dialog: Oops!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: "Whoops"?

Name: Lomond
Dialog: Well, it might've heard me think that it should not eat the ship, uh, because it's already too fat...

Name: Lomond
Dialog: I'm so very sorry, Captain! I just... (to a spiritual vision) Master, when will I learn to control my thoughts?

Name: Dirk
Dialog: (getting rid of the vision) Lomond, I thought we talked about having space ghosts on my bridge! We're gonna have to escape using a course so dangerous, the Honey Badger fleet and space worms wouldn't dare follow! Newbie Navigator, set course 23/42-27.

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (shrieks in fear)

Name: Zarna
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Sophia
Dialog: But, Captain, that will take us straight through—

Name: Dirk
Dialog: That's right, Newbie Navigator! (dramatic closeup) The Giant Razor Crystal Asteroids with Volcanoes Nebula!

Name: Zarna
Dialog: The Honey Badgers and Space Worms are slowing down, Captain!

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Look, Captain!

Name: Lomond
Dialog: It's some kind of hidden city!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: My word! It's the Merlorian Ambush!

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (shrieks and pushes buttons on his control panel, setting off the ship's lasers destroying the buildings)

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Nosh, no, no, no! Stop firing! Stop! "Ambush" is the Merlorian word for "hidden city"! The Merlorians are mostly harmless!

Name: Zarna
Dialog: Captain, I'm reading 50 Merlorian warships powering up engines.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: "Mostly".

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (shrieks in sorrow)

Name: Dirk
Dialog: For five more minutes. Don't push your luck or it'll be ten! I sure hope the Scorpion Collective doesn't learn of this.

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Why not, Captain?

Name: Dirk
Dialog: They hate the Merlorians and vow to be the ones to destroy them. If they even heard that we shot at them, it would be—

Name: Zarna
Dialog: Picking up the entire Scorpion Collective fleet heading straight at us!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: How could they even—

Name: Sophia
Dialog: (giving her phone to Dirk) Better look at this, Captain.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: (reading a meme) "Feeling sad on a timeout for firing on the Merlorian hidden city"!!!! Nosh!!!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Okay, we're gonna plot a course so doubly insane dangerous that none of them would dare follow us! Newbie Navigator, new course 47/54.09!

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Uh, Captain, I'm not really familiar with that course.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: That's right, Newbie Navigator. (dramatic closeup) The Carlarian Nebula of 17 Suns and 14 Black Holes!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: If we fly through with the precise course, the immense gravitational forces should accelerate us beyond lightspeed-12 and shoot us straight for Earth. This is going to be a super-duper crazy maneuver. Raise the Ultimate Control Stick! (A joystick rises from the ground and lights up.)

Name: Sophia
Dialog: (aside, to Nosh) You can tell it's a really good one because it has a light inside.

Name: Nosh
Dialog: (growls in agreement)

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Gravitational forces going past Level 10!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: This might've been a mistake!

Name: Sophia
Dialog: Huzzah! We're through, sir! Traveling at lightspeed-22 on our way to Earth!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: (pushes button on his chair) This is Captain Dirk Mortenson calling Lunar Landing Control. Request to land.

Name: Lunar Landing Control
Dialog: (on speaker) Lemme guess

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Coming in hot!

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Another successful mission! Any sign of our pursuers?

Name: Zarna
Dialog: What's left of the sensors say there's something big coming in.

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Looks like the gravitational pull of that last nebula coalesced our pursuers into a... What would you call that shape?

Name: Rest of the crew
Dialog: A giant spike?

Name: Dirk
Dialog: Okay, maybe the Mortenson Victory Flyby wasn't a good idea.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait a minute! What happened to that spiky thing?! What happened to the Earth?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: All will be answered in the next episode. (He closes the laptop and heads for the door.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, okay! You're strong and cocky and dominatin' like Captain Dirk. Just play the next one. Please?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: As you wish!

Name: Caption
Dialog: In truth, Buford never really liked Space Adventure. He only said he did to get Baljeet to lower his guard and sit within reach so he could make him sick.
